arguments.query: Indexed Proportion Form 4-F Per Volume V Clause 29.2

statements.text: Amended VOL-V 29.2 requires the Indexed Proportion stated in Form 4-F to be within 50% to 70%.

evidence.words: the percentage stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, which shall be not less than fifty per cent (50%) and not more than seventy per cent (70%)

row.requirement: State in Form 4-F the Indexed Proportion (the percentage of the Availability Payment indexed to the published consumer price index until the end of the tenth year of operations), not less than 50% and not more than 70%.

interpretations.quote: the percentage stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, which shall be not less than fifty per cent (50%) and not more than seventy per cent (70%)

consequence.quote: Any conditional price, price subject to adjustment other than as provided in Volume V, or alternative price shall render the Proposal non-responsive.
consequence.gloss: PROPOSED: whether a stated Indexed Proportion outside the band is a price subject to adjustment other than as provided in Volume V is a HUMAN DECISION PENDING

interpretations.note: Derived consequence read with Form 4-F; the pack does not itself state a consequence for a value outside the band.
